$schema-note: The constellation pin-ledger witness — Q.WA4 §S4. The SHIPPED pin set (kf 4.4.0 → value.js ^1.1.0 → parse-that ^0.12.0 transitive; glass-ui ~4.0.0 installs 4.0.1) made a single machine-readable record so the caret-pin silent-consume (B6-crossrepo-versions) is an OBSERVABLE edge. proof:pin-ledger-current (scripts/proof-pin-ledger-current.mjs) reads the LOCAL package.json declared pins + the installed tree (node_modules/<pkg>/package.json) + the lockfile and HARD-asserts they equal `shipped` (device-independent, pure-filesystem). The `npm view` registry cross-check is OBSERVE-ONLY (declarePosture). The `target` rows record the Q re-pin frontier (the consume edges Q.WG4 fires) WITHOUT a network/sibling dependency.

shipped.$comment: The pins the SHIPPED 4.4.0 keyframes.js declares + installs. `declared` is read from the LOCAL package.json (the pin spec); `installed` is read from node_modules/<pkg>/package.json (the resolved tree) + cross-checked against package-lock.json. The HARD clause reds on ANY drift from these. Source-of-record: package.json dependencies.@mkbabb/value.js (^1.1.0), package.json optionalDependencies.@mkbabb/glass-ui (~4.0.0); value.js 1.1.0's own dependencies declare parse-that ^0.12.0 (transitive).

pins.name: @mkbabb/value.js
pins.note: the caret pin — a future value.js 1.2.0 is auto-consumed with NO re-pin observable until Q.WG4 records the ^1.2.0 re-pin (the `target` row). This ledger makes that silent-consume an OBSERVABLE edge.

pins.name: @mkbabb/parse-that
pins.note: kf does NOT declare parse-that directly (the S9 dep removal — constellation IMPL drive); it arrives transitively through value.js 1.1.0's own `dependencies` (@mkbabb/parse-that ^0.12.0). The HARD clause asserts the INSTALLED transitive version only (kf declares no spec to drift).

pins.name: @mkbabb/glass-ui
pins.note: the tilde pin admits 4.0.x patch only; ~4.0.0 installs 4.0.1. The glass-ui BC cut (Q.WG3) re-pins the peer range to admit 5.0.0 — recorded in the `target` row.

target.$comment: The Q TARGET pins — the consume edges Q.WG4 / Q.WG-GATED-CONSUMES re-pin ON the sibling publish. These are RECORDED here so the caret-pin consume is an explicit, observable edge a future audit can check (B6-crossrepo-versions). They are NOT asserted by the HARD clause (the publish has not fired on today's tree — the DAG's no-unpublished-consume invariant forbids consuming them early); they are the witness frontier, reported OBSERVE-ONLY against the registry.
